description: Provider-free generic AI agent state store package for session snapshots, resumable checkpoints, redacted input/output refs, trace correlation, deterministic cache keys, memory context projection, and clean-skip adapter boundaries.
test_gates: agent state store contract fixture decodes without provider SDKs, live databases, credentials, or network access
state_version is monotonic and resume_token derives from checkpoint_key
input_refs and output_refs store stable digests and redacted summaries instead of raw payloads
trace correlation links agent_run_id, session_id, turn_id, event_id, parent_event_id, and checkpoint_key
trace replay projection maps checkpoint snapshots to deterministic trace and replay correlation events
memory context projection maps ranked memory refs into resumable snapshots without copying raw memory text
checkpoint and cache keys are deterministic sha256 values that exclude raw inputs, raw outputs, and secret-shaped fields
adapter boundaries clean-skip when durable state dependencies are absent

no_built_in_guarantee.statement: Leia core does not provide built-in leia-generic-ai-agent-state-store handling; this provider-free package boundary owns resumable agent state, checkpoints, redacted refs, trace correlation, memory context projection, and clean-skip contracts.

credentials.policy: No credentials are declared by leia-generic-ai-agent-state-store; provider credentials belong only to provider-specific adapter packages behind explicit capability gates.
